name: Secrets of the Colossus - Zora
label: Quest
description: Secrets of the Colossus - Zora: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My servants were nearly killed in their efforts to recover this sample. You absolutely must hurry! Lord Maxwell Tyrosus eagerly awaits a fresh husk sample. He believes that the secrets of this Colossus could help us in the war against the Scourge!
Why are you still here!? To Light's Hope! Yes, you will be rewarded handsomely for your efforts...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look a bit heavy in the boots, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent and timely! Well done, friend.
